slice: D2 - outdoor, garden, pets and cars

ideas.name: Nordic Window Bird Feeder + Seed Refill Club
ideas.concept: Clear window-mounted bird feeder (stock acrylic, no new moulds, custom wood/metal frame and branding) bundled with a Nordic-species ID card and recurring seed-refill packs.
ideas.target_customer: Swedish/Danish homeowners and flat dwellers, 30-65, bird-curious families, gift buyers.
ideas.problem_solved: Close-up birdwatching from indoors in cold, wet weather without going outside.
ideas.trend_evidence: Instagram reel and TikTok videos of a clear window bird feeder going viral, plus a YouTube 'Top 5 window bird feeders of 2026' and a CBS segment on birdwatching's TikTok-fuelled resurgence. All seen only as search excerpts; no view counts or EU supply-density data verified, and Amazon listings for generic feeders are likely numerous.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Generic feeder is copyable; moat is the Nordic design plus species-card content, seed/refill ecosystem and a Scandinavian birding creator community.
ideas.est_landed_cost_eur: 6-9 feeder; seed refills sourced locally, check food/feed rules

ideas.name: Nordic Wet-Weather Dog Walk Kit
ideas.concept: Reflective, waterproof waxed-canvas walk pouch with poop-bag roll, treat pocket and leash clip, plus matching leash wrap; cut-and-sew only, no hard tooling.
ideas.target_customer: Dog owners in Sweden/Denmark, 25-50, design-conscious, walking in rain and dark months.
ideas.problem_solved: Carrying bags, treats and phone cleanly and visibly during wet, dark Nordic walks.
ideas.trend_evidence: The Guardian reports the dog clothing market soaring on cold, wet weather with premium brands entering, and a 2026 dog-lifestyle trends post cites slower walks and refined accessories. #PetTok list highlights walking accessories (travel bottle with poop-bag compartment). Nordic-specific demand and competitor density not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Scandinavian design language, own pattern/colourways and reflective detailing, limited drops; brand and community rather than IP.

ideas.name: Lick Mat Collection with Recipe Cards
ideas.concept: Design-led food-grade silicone lick mats in distinctive patterns, sold as a set with a seasonal recipe-card subscription (dog-safe home recipes, no health claims); tooling via low-cost silicone compression mould, quote needed.
ideas.target_customer: Urban dog and cat owners 25-45 who buy enrichment and share on Instagram.
ideas.problem_solved: Boredom and calming enrichment for pets at home, grooming and bath distraction (framed as enrichment, not medical).
ideas.trend_evidence: An Instagram post cites analysis from Years that searches for 'dog lick mat' hit a five-year high, up 51% year on year. Enrichment kits (snuffle mat, ball, lick mat) are already sold by D2C brands like Reggie, so market is filling. Source is a secondary snippet; EU-specific volume not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own pattern designs (registered Community design) plus recurring recipe content; weak against cheap Amazon lookalikes.

ideas.name: Cat-Safe Door Latch, Scandinavian Design
ideas.concept: Premium, tool-free door strap/latch letting cats through while keeping dogs and toddlers out of the litter room, in textile plus stainless hardware with design-led colours.
ideas.target_customer: Multi-pet households, flat dwellers and parents of toddlers in Nordic cities.
ideas.problem_solved: Dog access to the litter box and cat food, and cat tail-pinch from closing doors.
ideas.trend_evidence: Neobay adjustable door strap is on a TikTok-made-me-buy pet list (BestReviews, May 2026). Only one editorial source seen; trend velocity and EU brand density unverified, and retail price may struggle above EUR 15 for commodity versions.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak; only design, materials and bundle (latch plus litter-area mat) differentiate; hardware is easy to copy.

ideas.name: Car and Dog Hair Detailer Duo
ideas.concept: Reusable rubber-and-wood pet hair raking tool plus crevice brush, packaged as a car-boot kit for dog owners; branded with own tool profile and carry bag.
ideas.target_customer: Dog-owning drivers in Sweden/Denmark, 28-55, Amazon EU shoppers.
ideas.problem_solved: Removing pet hair from car carpets and seats where vacuums fail.
ideas.trend_evidence: Lilly Brush pet hair detailer is on a TikTok-made-me-buy pet list with 4.6 stars and 50,000+ Amazon reviews (US listing); a car-accessories trend piece lists cleaning gadgets and detailing brushes as popular. Proof of demand is strong but it is an established product, so likely mature with copies in the EU.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Low; only own tool profile (design registration) and Nordic car-dog-owner brand positioning. Likely close to a lookalike risk; include only if a distinct design emerges.

ideas.name: Muddy-Paw Mat and Wipe Station
ideas.concept: Entryway kit for rainy-season dogs: washable microfibre absorbent paw mat plus lidded wipe-and-towel hook set, sewn textile, no moulds, aimed at the Nordic mudroom.
ideas.target_customer: Dog owners in houses and flats in SE/DK, design-aware, 30-55.
ideas.problem_solved: Mud and wet floors from paws after walks in autumn/winter.
ideas.trend_evidence: Portable paw cleaners (Dexas MudBuster) are listed as viral on TikTok pet lists; a trend roundup lists mudrooms and washable rugs as rising home themes. Both are secondary sources, so the Nordic velocity is unverified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design plus mudroom-system bundle (washable refill towels) rather than IP; moderate.
